   116→    /// Get or create the local rider profile.
   117→    pub fn get_or_create_rider(&self, user_id: &Uuid) -> Result<Rider, DatabaseError> {
   118→        // Try to get existing rider
   119→        if let Some(rider) = self.get_rider(user_id)? {
   120→            return Ok(rider);
   121→        }
   122→
   123→        // Create new rider with default values
   124→        let now = Utc::now();
   125→        let rider = Rider {
   126→            id: *user_id,
   127→            display_name: format!("Rider{}", &user_id.to_string()[..4]),
   128→            avatar_id: None,
   129→            bio: None,
   130→            ftp: None,
   131→            total_distance_km: 0.0,
   132→            total_time_hours: 0.0,
   133→            sharing_enabled: true,
   134→            created_at: now,
   135→            updated_at: now,
   136→        };

   138→        self.insert_rider(&rider)?;

   140→    }

   142→    /// Get a rider by ID.
   143→    pub fn get_rider(&self, rider_id: &Uuid) -> Result<Option<Rider>, DatabaseError> {
   144→        let mut stmt = self
   145→            .conn
   146→            .prepare(
   147→                "SELECT id, display_name, avatar_id, bio, ftp, total_distance_km,
   148→                        total_time_hours, sharing_enabled, created_at, updated_at
   149→                 FROM riders WHERE id = ?1",
   150→            )
   151→            .map_err(|e| DatabaseError::QueryFailed(e.to_string()))?;
   152→
   153→        let mut rows = stmt
   154→            .query(params![rider_id.to_string()])
   155→            .map_err(|e| DatabaseError::QueryFailed(e.to_string()))?;
   156→
   157→        if let Some(row) = rows
   158→            .next()
   159→            .map_err(|e| DatabaseError::QueryFailed(e.to_string()))?

   172→                                    total_time_hours, sharing_enabled, created_at, updated_at)

   178→                    rider.bio,
   179→                    rider.ftp,
